pages.text: A cache the Transcendental keeps for itself - and the one you can build: 243 kinds of item, and up to $(thing)2,147,483,647$() of each. Whatever you put in joins the pile of the same item. Scroll to move through its 27 rows; a click or shift-click takes one normal stack at a time.
Pipes put into it and take out of it (one stack at a time). Broken, it keeps everything inside. It is made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
